messages:
ashley: Quick thread: proposing a compact "net token" column in the cost dashboard that shows raw_tokens - credited_tokens per route. Rationale: teams want a single-line metric but still be able to inspect credits provenance.
michael: Love the simplicity. Can we ensure credits provenance is accessible without toggling too many filters? Maybe a small chevron to expand to a 3-line breakdown (raw, credits, net).
rashid: Implementation note: credits come from two places: (A) prefetch/cache origin, (B) chain-level KV cache hits. We should normalize credits into token_equiv and include a source tag ("prefetch"/"chain"/"cache_origin"). That way UI can group.
zoe: UX asks: default sort should be by net token cost, but also allow a toggle to show "potentially inflated credits" where sampling uncertainty > 20%. We don't want teams surprised by wild swings.
ashley: Good point re: sampling. Propose we surface a small badge "sample-adjusted" and a tooltip: "credits estimated from sampled traces; confidence: 87%". Also add a column showing sample_rate used to compute upweighting.
michael: Billing implications: for Dedicated customers we must keep an option to disable credit adjustments (show raw usage only). That can be an account-level flag.
rashid: SQL-ish sketch for daily aggregate that feeds dashboard:```sql
-- input: invocations(id, route, baseline_tokens, actual_tokens, sample_rate, cache_origin_route, parent_id)
with saved as (
  select id,
         greatest(baseline_tokens - actual_tokens, 0) as tokens_saved,
         sample_rate,
         cache_origin_route,
         parent_id,
         route
  from invocations
  where baseline_tokens > actual_tokens
), adjusted as (
  select id,
         tokens_saved / nullif(sample_rate,1) as tokens_saved_adjusted,
         case when cache_origin_route is not null then cache_origin_route else route end as credited_route,
         'prefetch' as source
  from saved
)
select credited_route as route,
       sum(tokens_saved_adjusted) as credited_token_equiv
from adjusted
group by credited_route;
```
zoe: A few policy decisions we need to decide now: (1) prefer cache_origin_route attribution for TTL window, (2) when multiple origins, split by recent access_count, (3) cap per-invocation credit at baseline_tokens to avoid negative net costs.
ashley: Agreed on those three. Also add auditability: store an immutable daily file (credits_v1 YYYYMMDD) with the rule version used so finance can reconcile.
michael: Ops: make aggregation idempotent and include provenance fields so we can re-run with different rule versions if needed. Also include a boolean "explicitly_disabled_for_dedicated" per-account so UI respects Dedicated raw view.
rashid: Perf: rather than walking full chains online, emit a compact event at router time: `credit_hint(credited_route, tokens_saved_estimate, sample_rate, rule_ver)` which the batch job can ingest for quick sums.
zoe: UI copy: dashboard column name options: "Net tokens", "Net tokens (after credits)", "Raw tokens / Credits / Net". My vote: show as "Net tokens" with expandable breakdown.
ashley: I'll draft the PR with schema and an export format for finance (CSV with raw_tokens, credited_tokens_by_source, net_tokens, sample_rate, rule_ver). Assign: @rashid build credit_hint emit, @zoe mock UI + copy, @michael docs for Dedicated behavior.
